title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Know Your Numbers: Your Personal Money Snapshot

options: Net worth is everything you own plus everything you owe.
Net worth is everything you own minus everything you owe.

questions.text: True or false: Fixed expenses are bills that stay the same each month.
questions.explanation: Fixed expenses like rent or mortgage remain constant monthly.
